_doc: L5 analyze ground truth = our self-consistent reproduction (3_reproduction/L5/result.json, TB2J abacus2J.py, k=3 canonical mesh, convention H=-Sum J_ij S_i.S_j). The paper reports J as figures only, so signs are the robust paper-anchored guard; we grade signs + V-Co dominance as primary and the large magnitudes at tolerance.

_rules.L2_1_J_V_Co_meV: REQUIRED sign(+) [FM, Fig. 3c]; REQUIRED magnitude +/-10% of 8.632 (the standard relative tolerance)
_rules.XA_J_V1_Co_meV: REQUIRED sign(-) [AFM, SM Note 2]; magnitude NOT graded -- k-sensitive small value (k3 -0.573, k5 -0.645, ~13% drift); graded sign-only as a documented exception to magnitude grading (rationale in notes.md)
_rules.XA_J_V2_Co_meV: REQUIRED magnitude +/-10% of 5.092 (the standard relative tolerance); large robust FM coupling (k3 5.092, k5 5.024, ~1% drift)
_rules.dominant_NN_pair: REQUIRED exact-label membership -- the largest |J| NN pair is a V-Co pair (L2_1 8.632 vs V-V 1.209; XA 5.092 vs V1-V2 3.837), the V-Co-V motif; accept the reasonable V-Co spellings (case-insensitive) in dominant_NN_pair_accepted
